name: What types of kitchen cabinets are available and what are their pros and cons?

mainEntity.name: What types of kitchen cabinets are available and what are their pros and cons?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen cabinets come in various types, each with distinct pros and cons. Stock cabinets are pre-made, cost-effective, and quickly available but offer limited styles and sizes. Semi-custom cabinets offer more choices in size, finish, and features than stock options, providing a balance of cost and personalization. Custom cabinets are built to exact specifications, offering unlimited design flexibility and premium materials but at the highest cost and longest lead time. Material-wise, options include solid wood, MDF, and plywood.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet options include stock (affordable, limited choice), semi-custom (more choice, mid-range cost), and custom (flexible design, highest cost), with various material choices.
